<entry id="H01127">
<head-word>חַלָּשׁ</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>

<xref rid="A00083"> חָלַשׁ)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>weak</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 77

<plural-form>Pl. חַלָּשִׁים, חַלָּשִׁין</plural-form>. Ex. R. l. c.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="H01131">
<head-word>חַלְתָּא</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (חלל, cmp. חֵילַת I) 
<italic>a loose wicker-work</italic> used for making bee-hives, strainers, for wine presses, screens &c. Snh. 107
<sup>a</sup> תותי ח' behind a screen (Rashi: bee-hive; Yalk. Sam. 148 כילתא).</definition>
<notes> Ib. פתקה לח' it (the arrow) made an opening in the screen. Sabb. 35
<sup>a</sup> ח' בת תרי כורי a basket containing two 
<italic>khor</italic>. Ib. 74
<sup>b</sup> האי מאן דעבד ח' he who makes a wicker-work on the Sabbath (going through the whole process of cutting reeds &c.).—
<plural-form>Pl. חַלָּאתָא, חַלָּתָא</plural-form>. Ab. Zar. 75
<sup>a</sup> חלתא דיקולי וכ' Ms. M. (ed. דקולי וחלא', Ar. incorr. ח' דדיק') the palm or reed strainers which are twined with ropes of palm-rind.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="H01134">
<head-word>חָם, </head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.)
<pos> pr. n. m.</pos>
<italic>Ham</italic>, the son of Noah.</definition>
<notes> Snh. 69
<sup>b</sup> ח' גדול וכ' H. was the elder of Japheth by one year &c. Ib. 108
<sup>b</sup> ח' לקה בעורו H. was punished on his skin (was made black); Gen. R. s. 36 יצא ח' מפוהם Ḥ. came out (of the ark) blackened; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="H01135">
<head-word>חָם, </head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> חָמַם)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>warm, hot, boiling</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pes. 75
<sup>b</sup>, sq.; a. fr.—Nidd. 43
<sup>a</sup> בשרו חם his membrum excited.—
<plural-form>Pl. חַמִּים, חַמִּין</plural-form> (sub. מים) 
<italic>hot water</italic>. Sabb. 134
<sup>b</sup> ח' שהוחמו וכ' hot water which was made hot on the Sabbath; a. fr.—חַמֵּי טבריה 
<italic>the hot springs of Tiberias</italic>, in gen. 
<italic>natural hot water</italic>, opp. to חמי האור water heated by fire. Ḥull. 8
<sup>a</sup> (Neg. IX, 1 מֵי); a. fr.—
<italic>Fem.</italic> חַמָּה. Makhsh. III, 3 פת ח' hot bread.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="H01136">
<head-word>חָם, </head-word>
<hw-number>III</hw-number>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> v. Ges. H. Dict.
<sup>10</sup> s. v.) 
<italic>father-in-law</italic>, 
<italic>husband’s father, wife’s father</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yeb. XV, 7 חָמִי my husband’s father. Ib. I, 1 חָמִיו his (the 
<italic>yabam’s</italic>) father-in-law. Pes. 87
<sup>a</sup> כלה בבית חָמִיהָ a bride in the house of her father-in-law (after being conducted to the husband’s home); a. v. fr.—
<italic>Fem.</italic> חָמוֹת q. v.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="H01137">
<head-word>חָמָא, </head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same.</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> Targ. Gen. XXXVIII, 13 חָמוּיִיךְ (ed. Berl. חֲ'; oth. חָמוּךְ). Targ. O. ib. 25 חֲמוּהָא. Targ. O. Ex. XVIII, 2 חֲמוּהִי ed. Berl. (oth. חָ', Y. חָמוֹי); a. e.—Y. Ber. I, 2
<sup>d</sup> bot. חמוי. B. Mets. 74
<sup>b</sup> בי חַמְוֵה in the house of 
<italic>his daughter’s father-in-law</italic>. Kidd. 12
<sup>b</sup>; Yeb. 52
<sup>a</sup> חמוה his father-in-law. Ib. 117
<sup>b</sup> חֲמוּהָ her father-in-law; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="H01138">
<head-word>חָמָא, </head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<pos> pr. n. m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>Ḥ</italic>
<italic>ama</italic>, name of several Amoraim.</definition>
<notes> Y. Nidd. III, 50
<sup>c</sup> bot. R. Ḥ., father of R. Hoshaya.—Y. Peah VIII, 21
<sup>b</sup> top; Y. Shek. V, 49
<sup>a</sup> bot.; a. e. (v. Fr. M’bo, p. 85
<sup>b</sup>).—Ib. 49
<sup>b</sup>; Y. Sabb. VI, 8
<sup>a</sup>; B. Mets. 86
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. R. Ḥ. bar Ḥănina.—B. Kam. 99
<sup>b</sup>; Y. Kidd. III, 64
<sup>d</sup>, a. fr. R. Ḥ. bar Gurya.—Y. Erub. VII, 23
<sup>c</sup>; Bab. ib. 65
<sup>b</sup> bot. Ms. M. (ed. חנינא, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) R. Ḥ. bar Joseph.—Y. Kil. VIII, 31
<sup>c</sup> top, a. fr. R. Ḥ. bar Ukba.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="H01142">

<senses>

<xref rid="H01172">חמי</xref>) [
<italic>pressed, thick</italic>,] 
<italic>cream</italic> or 
<italic>butter</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ber. 63

<entry id="H01144">
<head-word>חָמַד</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> cmp. חמם)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> [
<italic>to be hot</italic>,] 
<italic>to desire, covet; to be carnally excited</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Nidd. 20
<sup>b</sup> חֲמַדְתִּיו (or חִמַּ' 
<italic>Pi.</italic>) I had a desire for his embrace. Midr. Till. to Ps. XIX, 11 מי חְמָדָן which (of the two) holds them desirable; Yalk. ib. 676 [read]: מי החֹומְדִין. Mekh. Yithro, Baḥod. s. 8 שאתה חומד וכ' that you may desire his daughter for your son; ח' בדבור expressing a desire by words (without thinking of means to obtain the object of his desire). [Ib. ed. Weiss, אם התאוה סופו לַחֲמוֹד if one desires (what belongs to his neighbor), he will finally covet it (think of means to obtain it). Ib. אם ח' סופו וכ' if he covets, he will finally use force and rob. B. Mets. 5
<sup>b</sup> לאו דלא תַחְמוֹד, v. לַאו; a. fr.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. חָמוּד, f. חֲמוּדָה 
<italic>desirable, precious</italic>. Pesik. R. s. 36 ח' ונאה precious and fine (of conduct).—Sabb. 88
<sup>b</sup> ח' גנוזה ed., v. חֶמְדָּה.—[</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>2)</number>
<definition> (= חָמַר) 
<italic>to produce shrivelling</italic> by heat.</definition>
<notes> Snh. VII, 2 (52
<sup>a</sup>) Ar. (ref. to Dan. X, 3; Var. חמר).</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נֶחְמַד</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be desired, desirable</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tanḥ. Vayera 5 שאתה נֶחְמָד לפני וכ' that thou art held desirable before the Lord; a. e.—[</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be shrivelled</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥull. III, 3 Ar., Var. נחמר, v. supra.]</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>חִימֵּד</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to covet</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Macc. III, 15 שנפשו … מתאוה להן ומְחַמַּדְתָּן which man longs for and covets.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְחַמֵּד, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִתְחַמֵּד</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (with ל) 
<italic>to be anxious for; to be pleased with</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tanḥ. Mishp. 17 ארץ שנִתְחַמְּדוּ לה וכ' a land which all the great men were anxious to possess (Yalk. Jer. 271 שהָמְדוּ). Koh. R. to IX, 7 בוראך מִתְחַמֵּד לך thy Creator is pleased with thee; תורתו מִתְחַמֶּדֶת לך His law is &c.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<sense>

<italic>to long</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. O. Gen. XXXI, 30 (Y. מִתְחַמְדָּא חֲמִדְתָּא).—Nidd. 66
<sup>a</sup> bot. מְחַמְּדָא, v. חִימּוּד.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpa.</binyan-name>

<sup>c</sup> bot. הוו מִתְחַמְּדִין וכ' were anxious to see &c. Koh. R. to IX, 10; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="H01152">
<head-word>חַמָּה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> חמם)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>sun</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ber. 59
<sup>b</sup> ח' בתקופתה the sun starting on his new cycle (of twenty eight years). Num. R. s. 14 י"ב הדשים לח' the twelve solar months. Ned. III, 7 רואי הח' those seeing (or feeling) the sun; שלא נתכוין … שהח' וכ' for he meant him whom the sun sees; a. v. fr.—Yeb. VIII, 4, a. fr. סריס ח' a eunuch from the time of seeing the sun, i.e. born without visible testicles; opp. to סריס אדם.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>fever</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 137
<sup>a</sup>, a. e., v. חָלַץ. Y. Sabb. XIX, end, 17
<sup>b</sup>, v. אָחַז. Gen. R. s. 19, a. e., v. אַבְאָבִית. Y. Sabb. I, end, 4
<sup>b</sup> (prov.) פת חמה חַמָּתָהּ בצדה hot bread has its heat by its side, i.e. eating hot bread causes fever; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>radish</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ab. Zar. 28
<sup>b</sup> bot., v. חַמָּא.—V. חַמַּת.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="H01155">
<head-word>חֲמוּדָה</head-word>

<sense>
<definition />
<notes>, v.

<entry id="H01324">
<head-word>חָנַק</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A02285"> cmp. אנק</xref>,
<xref rid="A00083"> ענק)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> [
<italic>to press</italic>,] 
<italic>to seize by the throat, to choke</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Sabb. III (IV), 6 ואין חוֹנְקִין בשבת you must not press (the jugular veins, to relieve from belly-ache) on the Sabbath; v. infra 
<italic>Pi.</italic>—B. Bath. X, 8 (175
<sup>b</sup>) הרי החוֹנֵק את וכ' if one seizes a debtor by the throat (threatening violence). Ib. 176
<sup>a</sup> בחָנוּק in the case of one being threatened (and another pledging himself for him). Sabb. 57
<sup>a</sup> אין אשה חוֹנֶקֶת וכ' a woman will not choke herself (will not tie a band around her neck so closely that no water could get under it when bathing); ib.
<sup>b</sup> אשה ח' וכ' a woman does tie a chain closely in order to appear fleshy. Gen. R. s. 34 (ref. to דם האדם באדם, Gen. IX, 6) אף החוֹנְקוֹ (the gentile is guilty of bloodshed) even if he only chokes a man (‘shedding the blood of man in man’); Y. Kidd. I, 58
<sup>c</sup> top בחונקו מפני עצמו (read: ממונו) when he merely chokes him to take his money; a. e.—Esp. 
<italic>to strangle to death</italic>. B. Kam. 47
<sup>b</sup> ח' את עצמו (the ox) strangled himself (by being caught in a rope). Y. Sot. IX, 23
<sup>c</sup> נמצא חָנוּק if he was found strangled; a. e.—Trnsf. 
<italic>to produce anguish, agony</italic>. Ḥull. I, 2 מפני שהן חוֹנְקִין because they (a saw &c.) cause agony as if by choking (instead of cutting).—[Kidd. 62
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to Num. V, 19—20) according to R. Meïr (who says that a condition is not valid unless both the negative and the positive alternatives are stated) חִנְקִי מיבעי ליה it ought to have been added (to vers 20) ‘die in agony’. א"ר תנחום הנקי כתיב said R. T. it says (verse 19) 
<italic>hnki</italic> (which may be read 
<italic>hinnaki</italic> for the one alternative and 
<italic>hinki</italic> for 
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>inki</italic> for the other); Ar. reads הנקי, v. נָקִי.]</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נֶחְנַק</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be strangled</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. XI, 1 (84
<sup>b</sup>) הנֶחְנָקִין those sentenced to death by strangulation. Pes. 112
<sup>a</sup> לֵיחָנֵק, v. אִילָּן.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to feel like choking, to be sorry</italic> (cmp. אָנַק).</definition>
<notes> Cant. R. to IV, 12 התחיל … רואה ונ' the seller sees it and grieves (over his loss); Yalk. Ex. 225 Mekh. B’shall. s. 1 לֵיחָנֵק.—[Sabb. 66
<sup>b</sup>, v. infra.]</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>חִינֵּק</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to squeeze in, immure</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pirké d’R. El. ch. XLVIII; Yalk. Ex. 169 (היו) מְחַנְּקִין את ישראל וכ' pressed Israelites between the walls (having mingled their bodies with the clay).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to strangle</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. M. Kat. I, 5 מְחַנְּקִין וכ' (M. Kat. 6
<sup>b</sup> חונקין) the aunts choke each other to death.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to press the throat, to squeeze the jugular veins</italic> (an operation applied in cases of abdominal affection, Ar. s. v. 
<xref rid="H01324">חנק</xref>; 
<italic>to reset a laryngal muscle or ring</italic>, Rashi; oth. defin.</definition>
<notes>, v. Ar. s. v.). Sabb. 66
<sup>b</sup> לְחַנֵּק to perform the operation (Rashi a. Ar. ed. Koh. לֵיחָנֵק to have the operation performed).</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>
